content: Pekuru meta Wani 'itsɨkate wahɨxie kememɨte'utahɨawarie
Mexi'akuxi Pekuru meta Wani teɨteri metewakuxaxatɨwakai, yapauka mawari wewiwamete wahetsɨa mekaniu'axɨani, tuki mɨhɨritɨarie meta Tsarutseutsixi wahamatɨa.
Waɨkawa mepɨha'akai teɨteri memɨtewa'ɨkitɨakaikɨ, memɨtewakuxaxatɨwakaikɨ kemɨranukuketɨarie mɨkite watsata, me'utiyuatɨ Ketsutsi mexatatɨ.
Pekuru meta Wani meputiwiyarie mɨkɨyɨrirɨmekaikɨri, mepɨwaranutaxɨri muwa me'ayetetɨ mepukatariyarie.
Yumɨiretɨ niuki memu'eni yuri mepɨte'uta'eri, 'ukitsi xeikɨa me'inɨaritɨ 'auxɨwime miriyari mepɨhɨkɨtɨkai.
Hikɨ 'uxa'arieka Kerutsaremetsie mepɨyukuxeɨri wa'ukiyarima, 'ukirawetsixi meta 'inɨari niukiyarikɨ memɨte'ɨkitametetɨkai.
Mana 'Anatsi mawari wewiwamete tiwa'aitɨwame meta Kaipatsi, Wani, 'Arekanituru meta yunaitɨ 'iwamama.
Mana yuhixɨapa mewati'uitɨaka mekaniwaku'iwawiyakaitɨni mɨpaɨ mekateniwaku'iwawiyakaitɨni: —¿Ke'anekame tɨrɨkariya xehexeiyatɨ, kemɨ'ane hetsɨa xemiemetɨtɨ mɨya xepɨteyurie xeme?
Hikɨ Pekuru 'Iyari Mɨtiyupatakɨ hɨnetɨ mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe: —Neuxei teɨteri wa'ukiyarima meta 'ukirawetsixi:
Hikɨ xemɨtatsiku'iwawiya 'aixɨa temiyurikɨ tewi huriekame, mɨkɨ 'aixɨareu'erietɨ matɨakɨ.

Mɨpaɨ xeketenemaika yunaitɨ xeme meta yunaitɨ 'Ixaheri teɨteriyari yameketemaika Ketsutsi Kɨritsitu natsaretitanaka hetsɨa mɨmiemekɨ, mɨkɨtsie tiwiyatɨ 'ena puwe xehɨxie 'aixɨa reu'erietɨ, xeme kuruxitsie xemikawi Ketsutsi, peru Kakaɨyari nenukuketɨani mɨkite watsata.
'Ikɨ Ketsutsi Kɨritsitu kanihɨkɨtɨni:
Nixewitɨ tawarita 'apɨka'uyeika tatsitawikweitsitɨanike. Xewitɨ mumawekɨ muyuawitɨa tame teɨteri tatsata kɨmana temɨtawikweitsitɨarienikɨ, mɨkɨ xeikɨa pukayerie».

Hikɨ wa'ukiyarima mewaxeiyatɨ kememɨtekuxatakai Pekuru meta Wani mekamamakame, mɨpaɨ metehetimaika hatsuaku memɨkateyɨ'ɨkitɨakaikɨ meta tixaɨtɨ memɨkatehɨmetɨkaikɨ, mekanihɨxiyakaitɨni, mekaniwaretimani Ketsutsi hamatɨa memu'u'uwakaikɨ.
Me'ixeiyatɨ mɨkɨ tewi 'aixɨamu'itɨariekai wa'aurie 'uweme, mepɨkayɨwawekairi memɨwaniukimakakɨ.
Hikɨ mekaniwarutanɨ'ani memanuyekɨnekɨ 'itsɨkate wahɨxie, mɨkɨ mekaniuyu'enieni mɨpaɨ me'utiyuatɨ:
«¿Keteteyurieni 'ikɨ teɨteri wahepaɨtsita? Yurikɨ wakɨmana 'inɨari pɨreyɨ, yunaitɨ kememɨtemate, kemɨtimatsiɨkɨ yunaitɨ Kerutsareme memɨtama wahɨxie. Tame tepɨkayɨwawe tema'imawani.
Matsi tawariri mukakuxaxatsiwanikɨ teɨteri watsata, kɨmɨ tepɨwata'imaiya mɨkɨ hepaɨtsita xeime memɨkatekuxaxatɨwanikɨ».
Yuhetsɨa mewarutakwewieka mɨpaɨ mekateniwaruta'imaiya memɨkatekuxatanikɨri meta memɨkate'ɨkitanikɨ Ketsutsi hetsiemieme.
Peru Pekuru meta Wani mɨpaɨ mekateniwaruta'eiya: —¿'Aixɨa ti'ane Kakaɨyari hɨxie xeme pɨta temɨxe'enieka mɨkɨ teka'enietɨ? Xekeneutimaixɨa kemɨ'ane heitserie mexeiya.
Tame tepɨkayɨwawe temɨtehayewa tetekuxatatɨ tita temɨte'uxei meta tita temɨte'u'eni hepaɨtsita.

Mɨkɨ tawarita yametewaruta'imaiyaku mekaniwarutatuani memɨyehukɨ. Teɨteri wahetsie tixaɨtɨ mepɨkate'ukaxei memɨwa'uximatɨakakɨ, yunaitɨ 'aixɨa Kakaɨyari hepaɨtsita memutiyuanekaikɨ mete'utamarieka kemɨtiuyɨ.
Mɨkɨ tewi huta tewiyari heimana yapaɨmeme wiyari pexeiyakai 'inɨarikɨ 'aixɨa mu'itɨarie.
Yuri memɨte'erie kememɨteyunenewiekai
Hikɨ Pekuru meta Wani me'utatuiyaka yuteɨterima wahetsɨa mekaniu'axɨani, mekateniwarutaxatɨani naime kememɨtewarekɨhɨawekai mawari wewiwametekɨ memɨhɨritɨarie meta 'ukirawetsixi.
Kepauka mewaru'enieka 'axeikɨa meyuxewitɨ Kakaɨyari nenewieri mekaniupitɨani: «Ti'aitame Naitsarie pemɨti'aita, muyuawi meta kwie pemutawewi, haramara meta naime wahetsie mɨtixuawe,
'ekɨ 'Iyari Mɨtiyupata hekɨ, Rawiri tatutsi mɨpaɨ petitaxatɨaku, ti'a'uximayatsiriwame mɨpaɨ putayɨ:

content.text: meta titayari teɨteri yakɨ xeikɨa metekuxata?

content: Yurikɨ 'ikɨ kiekaritsie mekaniyukuxeurieni Herurexi meta Punitsiyu Piratu, teɨteri memɨkahuriyutsixiri meta 'Ixaheri teɨteriyari, 'aniwe mɨpatsie 'ahetsiemieme Ketsutsi me'aye'unietɨ, kemɨ'ane pemanayexei,
mekaniyukuxeɨrieni yameteyurienike tita pemɨtiyurienikekai meripaitɨ yapɨtiyɨnikekai.
Hikɨ Ti'aitame keniwaru'eni 'axakememutiyuane, ketaneparewieka tame te'a'uximayatsiriwamete tixaɨtɨ tekateheumakatɨ 'aniuki temukuxatanikɨ.
'Ayumieme 'ekɨta 'amamakɨ keniwaparewieka teɨteri memanayexɨriyanikɨ meta 'inɨarikɨ mamariwaweme petiyurienetɨ 'aniwe Ketsutsi mɨpatsie hetsiemieme».
Hikɨ me'uyutanenewieku mana memayuxeɨrietsie kaniutayuani, yunaitɨ 'Iyari Mɨtiyupatakɨ mekaniutihɨne, Kakaɨyari niukieya mekanikuxatakaitɨni tixaɨtɨ mekateheumakatɨ.
Yuri memɨte'erie yupiinitekɨ kememɨteyuparewiekai
Yunaitɨ yuri memɨte'erie xei'iyariyari mekanexeiyakaitɨni meta yaxeikɨa mepɨteku'eriwakai. Nixewitɨ piinitɨarika yupiini pɨkarayeitɨwakai, matsi 'axeikɨa naime mekatenexeiyakaitɨni.
Nɨ'ariekate tɨrɨkaɨyemekɨ mekatenihekɨatakaitɨni Ti'aitame Ketsutsi kemɨranukuke hepaɨtsita. Kakaɨyari 'aixɨa katiniyuriekaitɨni yunaime mɨkɨ wahetsie,
xewitɨ reuyehɨatɨ mana pɨka'ukatei. Kemɨ'ane kwie meta kii, memexeiyakai mekanikutuayakaitɨni, kememɨte'ituani tuminiyari mekani'atɨwakaitɨni,
nɨ'ariekate wahetɨa mekanitimanakaitɨni, mɨkɨ yuxexuime kememɨteheuyehɨwa memɨtewayetuiriwanikɨ.
Hikɨ Kutse, rewi tewiyari pɨhɨkɨtɨkai, Tsipɨretsie kiekame, nɨ'ariekate Werunawe mekateniterɨwa (taniukikɨ Tiyɨnɨtɨwame panuyɨne),
mɨkɨ kwie mexeiyakai kaneituani, tuminiyari nɨ'ariekate wahetsɨa kani'atɨani.
